title: How Your Custom Sign Project Works
intro: Start with what you know. We’ll clarify the remaining details with you before confirming a quote and production specification.
body:
## 1. Share the Starting Point

Tell us the use, delivery country and preferred sign style. A logo, reference photo or initial idea is enough to begin. If dimensions, material or timing are undecided, say so rather than guessing a production specification.

## 2. Review the Design and Location

Continue the discussion with artwork, approximate dimensions, quantities and photos of the intended mounting area. We clarify the face, finish, depth, lighting and fixing direction, together with destination-specific requirements that need review.

## 3. Check the Project Quote

Read the proposed specifications, currency, included components, delivery scope, costs and exclusions. If information is provisional, ask which assumptions the quote uses and what could change when the details are confirmed. An enquiry or preliminary quote is not production approval.

## 4. Confirm the Order and Production Requirements

Confirm artwork, spelling, dimensions, finishes, lighting, quantities and approval responsibilities in writing. The quotation and order documents establish the seller, payment arrangements, applicable terms and the point at which fabrication is authorised.

## 5. Fabrication, Checks and Packing

The production partner works to the approved requirements. Agree in advance which appearance checks, lighting checks, inspection records, packing arrangements and dispatch information are needed. Supplier photographs are references, not proof that a particular order has passed inspection.

## 6. Shipping and Installation Preparation

Confirm the destination, shipping scope, production and transit timing, import responsibilities and the information required by the local installer. Identify any fixing, electrical connection, access or approval work outside the supplied scope before dispatch.

## Useful to Have, but Not Required to Start

- Your logo, text or reference image.
- Approximate dimensions and quantity.
- A photo of the intended location and mounting surface.
- Indoor or outdoor use.
- Delivery country and city.
- Preferred timing and any opening or installation deadline.

## Questions About the Process

### When is the price confirmed?

After the project information and scope have been reviewed. Confirm any assumptions, exclusions and validity conditions in the quotation before agreeing the order.

### Can I change the design after approval?

Contact your project representative promptly. Whether a change is possible, and any cost or timing impact, depends on the actual stage and agreed order terms. Do not assume a requested change has been accepted until confirmed.

### What if something arrives damaged or appears incorrect?

Keep the packaging, photograph the issue and contact the agreed project contact promptly with the order reference. The relevant order documents and support arrangements determine the next steps.

newBody:
## Share Your Brief

A logo, a reference or a photo of the space is enough to begin the discussion.

We review the starting information and clarify the style, size, quantity and any open requirements with you.

A saved enquiry and a clear starting point for your project.

## Specification & Quote

Bring the artwork, construction and supplied scope together before the order moves forward.

We review the artwork, materials, lighting, fixing and delivery requirements, then prepare a project-based quote.

Review the specification, price, inclusions and order terms. Approve the agreed requirements in writing before production.

## Production & Checks

The approved details guide fabrication, finishing and the checks required for your sign.

We make your sign to the confirmed requirements and carry out the agreed appearance, construction and lighting checks where applicable.

Complete the agreed order checks and confirm the packing and dispatch arrangements.

## Delivery Preparation

Plan the packing, shipment and local installation together, before dispatch.

We prepare the agreed protection and shipment arrangements, and confirm the supplied installation information.

Know the shipping scope, timing and import responsibilities. Resolve local fixing, electrical work and approvals with your installer.
